s01028.summary: Orsolya and Tavi drift through the frosted ring, calling out to anyone aboard.
Behind a wall panel she finds burned wiring and mutters that it was no accident.
She notices Tavi's trembling hand and gives him a screwdriver instead of the lantern.
Thuds roll through the ring; Tavi insists they sound close, Orsolya says far.
Orsolya calmly announces a recovery crew will leave in five minutes, though no one is there.
She tows Tavi gently to the airlock and pushes him through.
A small, almost polite knock sounds from the dark as she seals the hatch.
She stays motionless a long time while Tavi sets the lantern between them.

s01094.summary: Helena pulls up a loose board in the observatory and finds a hidden journal.
She reads the journal and finds a sketch with a red circle and the word NO.
Grant phones to warn her to wait; Helena says she is not alone.
She finds deliberate footprints leading to a half-open door.
A tall man in a gray overcoat steps slowly into the dome holding a brass key.
Helena asks if he killed Warrick; he says he was the student who closed the shutter.
He lifts the key and the dome shutter begins to close, cutting off the stars.
Helena shouts to Grant and hurls the journal; the dome slams shut in darkness.

s01065.summary: In a shabby housing court, the judge hears about a notice of rent increase.
Pratt says Marisela never got notice; Dexter claims it was posted in the lobby.
Pratt charges Dexter with collecting rent for a unit lacking a working stove for months.
The judge cuts them off while the leaky ceiling bucket pings.

s00006.summary: Merchants gather on the crest of a giant tortoise carrying a market.
The ground trembles as the tortoise stops and Maeve calls for quiet.
Dominic grumbles and Isolde tells him to keep quiet, hearing him call her a witch.
A groan rolls through the shell and Maeve orders everyone to hold the rails as it rises.

s01097.summary: Curling team members brood in the club bar after a one-stone loss.
Rags tells Lolo to put down her phone and snaps at Toby for second-guessing.
Toby blames Rags for calling the hammer late.
Rags slams her glass and insists she called it when the ice told her.
Rags softens, praises the team, and they toast the ninth end.

s01036.summary: Agnes pins a hem while Delphine stands on a stool avoiding the mirror.
Colonel Ashby-Grey arrives with Yusuf, insisting the wedding is Saturday.
He orders the bodice tightened while Yusuf measures with trembling fingers.
Delphine looks in the mirror and asks Yusuf how far away Damascus is.
Ashby-Grey narrows his eyes and says her name in warning.
Agnes touches Delphine's wrist and covers a slip about letting out the seam.
Ashby-Grey demands Saturday at ten and takes his hat and leaves.
Delphine steps down slowly from the stool as if from a scaffold.

s01042.summary: Coach paces and rallies her team, down two goals going into the third.
Coach tells Zeke he's the fastest on the ice despite his knee.
Mei-Ling punches her pads and promises no one gets past her.
The horn sounds and the team rises as one; Zeke limps then doesn't.

pd_earnest_1.summary: Jack and Gwendolen trade declarations and debate the name Ernest.
Jack suggests marrying at once and she teasingly says he hasn't proposed.
Jack kneels and proposes; Gwendolen accepts and critiques his technique.
Lady Bracknell enters and orders Jack to rise from his indecorous posture.
Gwendolen announces her engagement to her mother.
Lady Bracknell denies the engagement and sends Gwendolen to the carriage.
Gwendolen leaves reluctantly, blowing kisses behind her mother's back.

s01118.summary: Inspector Gwendolyn reads lighthouse logbooks in the foggy log room.
She spots an entry noting Mr. Pellew did not return, in the same hand and ink.
Held to the flame, the page shows a scratched-out line: He did not fall.
On the radio she presses the harbormaster about the empty boat and who lit the lamp.
A floorboard creaks above her and she eyes the spiral stair.
She pockets the log and climbs toward the sound.

s00000.summary: A flooded roller rink serves as courtroom, with Adaeze alone and Lev calm.
Lev calls the defendant's hospital stay convenient; Adaeze bristles.
Lev moves to proceed in absentia, citing a signed waiver.
Adaeze objects on constitutional grounds but is shown page four.
She finds the signature and notes it lacks his usual loop.
At the bench Adaeze accuses Lev of forging or allowing forgery.
Judge Tran rubs the signature and finds the ink still wet.
Lev's smile dies as the judge demands who re-signed the waiver.
A clerk appears holding a felt-tip, admitting Lev told her it was routine.
Lev sits; the judge grants dismissal with prejudice.
Adaeze exhales as court adjourns and the disco ball stops turning.

s01117.summary: Felix watches his grandmother stir porridge in the early kitchen.
Felix asks why his mother left.
Babcia tells him to eat first and serves porridge.
She says his mother wanted a different life, and the farm is not bad.
Felix asks if his mother will come back.
Babcia holds his hand and speaks of swallows returning; the mist lifts.

s01115.summary: Friends banter and tease in the treehouse as new neighbor Lotte watches.
Lotte offers licorice and is welcomed by the others.
They ask Lotte where she moved from; Rotterdam, she says, far away.
Four friends sit together in green quiet and a card drops into Lotte's lap.

s00015.summary: Five people stand around an empty coat in the observatory dome.
Hetty asks who last saw Doctor Marrow, pointing suspicion at Soli.
Bastian accuses Soli of lying about the keys; Soli says he misheard.
Mei-Ling catches Pratt contradicting his earlier claim he hadn't visited.
Hetty notes Pratt has a key, and four keys exist.
Bastian asks why Pratt's cane is wet.
Pratt claims rain; Soli says it hasn't rained since Tuesday.

s01032.summary: In a steamy mill, referee Henrik sets the hands for an arm-wrestling match.
Both tense; the table groans and neither gives while the crowd chants.
Pilar needles Jethro about his sweat and his mother's apron.
Jethro surges and pushes her hand an inch; she drives back to even.
They talk about Matanzas and laugh briefly while locked.
Jethro lunges, the table skids, and they tumble wrestling over barrels.
They call a truce till dawn and Henrik declares a draw.
They plan a rematch, joking about her dead father's arm.
Pilar slams her elbow on the plank and Jethro joins her again.

s01085.summary: Imogen and Suleiman sit silently in a night laundromat, glancing at each other.
She notes he folds before washing; they trade shy small talk.
They discover they are both night nurses and recall passing on the stairs.
Imogen pulls the lone blue sock from the dryer and asks if he's lost one.
He pulls out the matching blue sock from his cardigan pocket.
They agree on Tuesday; she hands over her sock and walks out into rain.

s01105.summary: Fionnuala scans the street through a scope atop the bombed cinema.
Falling masonry makes Fionnuala flinch; Ikenna restrains her annoyance at the old man.
Tavakoli apologizes and offers his knowledge of the roof.
She asks which boards creak; he points to a safe line of beams.
She sends wounded Ikenna crawling and tells Tavakoli to follow while she stays.
Ikenna reaches the beams and signals; Tavakoli crawls after him.
Fionnuala rises, raises her rifle, and takes aim at the flaring balcony light.

s01021.summary: Ignacio oils the lighthouse lens humming off-key.
Boots clang on the stairs and soaked Wren hauls herself through the hatch.
Ignacio says she can't be here; she says she rowed nine miles.
He reminds her she wrote a four-line letter saying she was done.
Wren notes he kept the light polished; she nearly drowned and he admits he'd have been oiling.
Wren asks him to say what he's been rehearsing.
They say I missed you at once, admitting anger and fear.
They joke about her dripping and an old tin of tea.
He takes her suitcase and they descend; the lens keeps turning.

s01037.summary: Roz and Trevor wait at a table in a rotating tower restaurant.
A young locksmith, Sunny, joins late and brings the codes.
Roz lays out the vault heist timed to the restaurant's rotation.
Sunny haggles over her cut and Roz settles at two and a half.
Sunny asks what-if questions as Roz answers with confident quips.
The city turns outside; Trevor finds it beautiful but Roz says it's a job.
Sunny and Roz clink glasses while Trevor hesitates.

s01024.summary: A small claims court convenes on a former skating rink.
Oyelaran and Hartmann argue over a contract exhibit while the judge tries to speak.
Hartmann calls the contract a forgery; Oyelaran claims slander.
The judge splinters her gavel and orders them both to sit.

s01074.summary: Gloria cuts cake in an office closet turned party room.
A tall unknown man with a clipboard lingers in the doorway.
He asks if the cake is a huddle; Dez grumbles that everything is.
Gloria asks his department and name; he turns out to be Bertram Hollis of Efficiency.
He says closets are being made efficient; Gloria defends it as morale.
Dez retorts that Bertram is not a line item either; silence follows.
A toner cart bumps the cake and all four lunge to save everything.
Holding the banner together, they declare alignment achieved and Bertram nearly smiles.
A mailroom kid asks if there's cake and Gloria tells him to cut another.

s01039.summary: Strangers in a night laundromat share tips and grumbles about the weather.
Elderly Walter shuffles in dragging a laundry bag, needing change.
Nadia gives him quarters and he blesses her.
Walter says his wife died last spring and he never learned laundry.
Nadia and Marisol say it's not hard in unison and smile.
Tucker invites Walter to sit, and the four share a quiet moment.

s01080.summary: The arbitrator reads her file as lawyer and client wait in the stuffy room.
She checks the tenant's claim of three cold winters and the landlord's denial.
Mrs. Yusupova says she knocked on his door and he once gave her a blanket.
She overrules Pike's objection and lets the blanket story continue.

s00002.summary: Tamsin traces spines in a flooded cathedral library full of bees.
Seraph Vane enters in a coat of feathers and asks for the keeper.
Tamsin slides the humming book back into place and the bees go quiet.
